open_findings.title: 90-day overplayed rest is bypassed by cooling fallback in normal deck planning
open_findings.preconditions: Unblocked imported song:8 counted plays400daysago,4 early skips last40daysago, playedBeforeSkips8. Station pool40 with39 noncooling alternatives; normal initial station round covers previous365days.
reproduction: onboarded({tracks:40}); choose actual first imported library song and first actual station.
Call actual public hub.newNativeQueue(station.id), inspect saved deck via read-only SQL.
open_findings.expected: Song is excluded until90days after last early skip, as the changed UI and feature contract promise. Ordinary noncooling alternatives remain available.
open_findings.actual: Song appears in40-item saved native deck on day40. Independent pure planner reproduces with one normal alternative too.
open_findings.cause: New90-day cooling shares the existing24-hour cooling lane. Default allowCooling includes that lane to fill a deck; 90-day condition does not establish a separate enforced rest.
